# PE Glossary / SCP Shorthand

- **MOIC** — Multiple on Invested Capital; total value returned ÷ capital invested (e.g. 2.5x).
- **IRR** — Internal Rate of Return; the time-weighted annualized return.
- **DPI** — Distributions to Paid-In; cash actually returned to LPs ÷ capital called ("realized").
- **TVPI** — Total Value to Paid-In; DPI plus unrealized ("paper") value.
- **LOI** — Letter of Intent; a non-binding offer that opens exclusivity and diligence.
- **SPA** — Sale & Purchase Agreement; the binding definitive deal document.
- **QoE** — Quality of Earnings; a diligence study that scrubs reported EBITDA for one-offs and
  aggressive add-backs.
- **EBITDA** — Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation & Amortization; the mid-market proxy
  for cash earnings and the basis for the purchase multiple.
- **Add-back** — an expense a seller argues is non-recurring, added back to boost EBITDA; QoE
  tests whether add-backs are legitimate.
- **TEV / Entry multiple** — Total Enterprise Value; the entry multiple is TEV ÷ EBITDA.
- **Re-trade** — reopening price after diligence findings to lower the agreed value.
- **Platform vs add-on** — the first acquisition in a vertical (platform) vs subsequent tuck-ins
  (add-ons / bolt-ons).
- **GP / LP** — General Partner (SCP, the manager) / Limited Partner (the fund's investors).
- **PIK** — Payment-In-Kind; interest that accrues to principal instead of paying cash.
- **CIM** — Confidential Information Memorandum; the sell-side book marketing a company for sale.
- **IC** — Investment Committee; SCP's deal-approval body, chaired by William Stonehaven.
- **Vintage** — the year a fund begins investing (Fund III is a 2023 vintage).
- **Onyx** — code name for a confidential live transaction; use the code name only.
